explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 62 named tracks and release cuts across September 2026 current-release coverage from Resident Advisor, Pitchfork and Bandcamp Daily; emerging artists and labels surfaced in Bandcamp Daily's August electronic round-up; Makaya McCraven's overlooked 2025 International Anthem material; adjacent Theon Cross and Ben LaMar Gay catalogue; and current STRANGE GAIT inside-out boundaries. Attributed criticism and official release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 169 selected, unresolved and duplicate identities were not recycled.
KAY BE, DJ Phil, DJ POPS, Nochi and other names surfaced by the current Bandcamp window were excluded after persistent-state checks showed earlier resolution, verdict, parking or unresolved history.
Failed Runs 164 and 167 remain technical non-completions and supplied no musical verdicts.
Every ranked Artist — Track pair was checked against the current ledger, discoveries, discovery pool, rejected, revisit and archived history before submission.
Only five honest leads survived; the request was not padded to nine.
All proposed placement URIs were derived from the current ledger and programmatically verified as adjacent before this request was written.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
sourceWindows: CURRENT WINDOW: Resident Advisor's live September 12, 2026 front page and September 11 new-music round-up were inspected for newly announced electronic releases; previously handled candidates were excluded. https://ra.co/

CURRENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Bandcamp Daily's September 9, 2026 electronic round-up surfaced emerging and current club/electronic releases, then persistent-state checks removed already handled identities. https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-electronic/the-best-new-electronic-music-on-bandcamp-august-2026

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Bandcamp Daily's October 29, 2025 Makaya McCraven review supplies exact-track descriptions for Gnu Blue and Boom Bapped and documents the live/studio reconstruction method. https://daily.bandcamp.com/album-of-the-day/makaya-mccraven-four-eps-review
